dialogues.jp: ――夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I can tell whether it's mine or not.
dialogues.text: I can tell whether it's mine or not.

dialogues.jp: 自分の夢じゃない。
dialogues.en: It's all dark. I have no idea what's going on.
dialogues.text: It's all dark. I have no idea what's going on.

dialogues.jp: これは他人の夢だろう。
dialogues.en: Whose dream am I in?
dialogues.text: Whose dream am I in?

dialogues.jp:
長年、この力で他人の夢を見ていると、時々わ
かることがある。
dialogues.en: Whoosh...
dialogues.text: Whoosh...

dialogues.jp:
辺りは真っ暗闇。何がどうなっているのかは、
わからない。
dialogues.en: The wind blows.
dialogues.text: The wind blows.

dialogues.jp: 誰の、何の夢だ。
dialogues.en:
I know this place. This is our secret place with the big
cherry tree.
dialogues.text:
I know this place. This is our secret place with the big
cherry tree.

dialogues.jp: ――ざざん。
dialogues.en: Cherry blossom petals are whirling around in the wind.
dialogues.text: Cherry blossom petals are whirling around in the wind.

dialogues.jp: 風の吹く音がした。
dialogues.en: I know there are some people there. But I can't see them.
dialogues.text: I know there are some people there. But I can't see them.

dialogues.jp: あの場所だ。大きな桜の咲いている秘密の場所。
dialogues.en: One is me as a little kid, but I can't see the little me.
dialogues.text: One is me as a little kid, but I can't see the little me.

dialogues.jp: 桜の花びらが、ひらひらと舞っている。
dialogues.en:
There's one more person. Who is it? Is it whoever's having
this dream now?
dialogues.text:
There's one more person. Who is it? Is it whoever's having
this dream now?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan..."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan..."

dialogues.jp: 美春か。
dialogues.en: Miharu?
dialogues.text: Miharu?

dialogues.jp: もしかして、美春の見ている夢だろうか。
dialogues.en: Am I in Miharu's dream?
dialogues.text: Am I in Miharu's dream?

dialogues.jp: 子供の頃の思い出を見ているのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Is this our childhood?
dialogues.text: Is this our childhood?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――お兄ちゃん、どこにいるの？」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan? Where are you?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan? Where are you?"

dialogues.jp: 子供の頃の俺と、子供の頃の美春。
dialogues.en: Me and Miharu as children.
dialogues.text: Me and Miharu as children.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「――ほら、見つけた。今度は、お兄ちゃんが
　鬼だよ」
dialogues.en: "I found you. It's your turn now."
dialogues.text: "I found you. It's your turn now."

dialogues.jp: かくれんぼか。そんなこと、あったっけ。
dialogues.en: Are we playing hide-and-seek?
dialogues.text: Are we playing hide-and-seek?

dialogues.jp: さすがに覚えてないな。
dialogues.en: I don't remember we played this.
dialogues.text: I don't remember we played this.

dialogues.jp: でも、懐かしい感じのする夢だ。
dialogues.en: This dream makes me feel nostalgic.
dialogues.text: This dream makes me feel nostalgic.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――美春は、今度こそ見つからないから」
dialogues.en: "You're not gonna find me..."
dialogues.text: "You're not gonna find me..."

dialogues.jp: 姿は見えなくても、俺には昔の記憶がある。
dialogues.en:
I can remember this much, although I don't see anything in
this dream.
dialogues.text:
I can remember this much, although I don't see anything in
this dream.

dialogues.jp:
アレ？　美春の子供の頃って、どんな服を着て
たっけ？
dialogues.en: Hmm? What kind of clothes was Miharu wearing as a kid?
dialogues.text: Hmm? What kind of clothes was Miharu wearing as a kid?

dialogues.jp:
まあ、どっちにしろ他人の夢である以上、どう
しようもないんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, I can't do anything about it since this is someone
else's dream.
dialogues.text:
Well, I can't do anything about it since this is someone
else's dream.

dialogues.jp:
夢というのは、よくわからないもので、ふたり
でしているかくれんぼが延々と続いていた。
dialogues.en: The kids keep playing hide-and-seek.
dialogues.text: The kids keep playing hide-and-seek.

dialogues.jp:
見せられる夢は、正直苦痛にもなりかねないが、
娯楽にだってなりはしない。
dialogues.en: It's no pain nor fun to keep having the dream.
dialogues.text: It's no pain nor fun to keep having the dream.

dialogues.jp: ただただ、延々とかくれんぼをする俺と美春。
dialogues.en: Miharu and I just keep playing.
dialogues.text: Miharu and I just keep playing.

dialogues.jp:
見ている俺は、あまりに退屈だったので、寝る
ことにした。
dialogues.en: I get so bored that I decide to sleep.
dialogues.text: I get so bored that I decide to sleep.

dialogues.jp: 夢の中で。
dialogues.en: In the dream.
dialogues.text: In the dream.

dialogues.jp:
器用なことができるものだと、我ながら感心し
つつ漆黒の闇の中へ落ちていく。
dialogues.en:
I don't even know how that works, but somehow I find myself
falling into darkness.
dialogues.text:
I don't even know how that works, but somehow I find myself
falling into darkness.

dialogues.jp: 心地よい、暗闇の世界。
dialogues.en: A comfortable darkness.
dialogues.text: A comfortable darkness.

dialogues.jp:
最後にもう一度――ざざん、と風の吹く音が聞
こえた。
dialogues.en: Again, I hear the sound of the wind -- it whooshes.
dialogues.text: Again, I hear the sound of the wind -- it whooshes.

dialogues.jp: ◆美春の夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆I had a dream.◆
dialogues.text: ◆I had a dream.◆

dialogues.jp: 美春の夢を見た。
dialogues.en: Not my dream.
dialogues.text: Not my dream.

dialogues.jp:
子供の頃の俺と、子供の頃の美春が延々とかく
れんぼをする夢だった。
dialogues.en: Someone else's.
dialogues.text: Someone else's.
